Senses.Explanation: “Not exchanged even for a whole kingdom” is the priceless side of a deliberate worthless–priceless reversal. Yuanjie Ying contrasts worth not a penny with refusal to exchange it for a kingdom. Dabo Qian independently repeats the no-price and whole-kingdom contrast. Two independent present source uses deepen the existing two public witnesses: Hansong quotes Yaoshan's original answer then critiques the adequacy of that answer in his own case comment. Yushan directly uses the phrase in his own evening sermon for the jewel he holds out to the assembly.

Occurrences.Kwic: 藥之靈驗易見，要須忌口乃可。不然，服藥何益？生死是大病，佛祖言教是良藥，染汙心是雜毒。不能忌之，生死之病，無時而損也。所謂染汙者，即愛憎、取舍、得失等心是也。若有纖毫未盡，則不知不覺，被目前境風所奪，日久月深，迷而不返，道力不能勝業力，千岐萬派，從此而起矣。其害有不可勝言者。是以契經曰：「若忘失菩提心，修種種行，皆成魔業。」又曰：「若起精進心，是妄非精進。但能心不妄，精進無有涯。」以上絡索，皆途程邊事。若夫向上一路，近來王令稍嚴，不許攙行奪市。與明兄與明兄病中不能作字，無字則意不能達，伏枕揮毫，竟不知從甚處起。若夫石梁嶮巇，華頂孤危，海門波濤浩蕩，瑞巖石上惺惺，到者自知，何必預搔待癢？寒溫間闊，問訊起居，又非病僧之所以示親愛也。因念古人凡遇顛危之後，必有大進益處。吾兄昔年死中得活，爐錘正自不小，想得力處亦自不少矣。年來袛聞翰墨淋漓，不許夜行

Senses.Explanation: Diligent practice has no limit when the mind does not fabricate: the positive half of an inherited Dharma-verse saying contrasting genuine effort with contrived zeal. Wuzhu and Fushi quote it in early and later instruction; Yunwai and Xieyun warn against different misreadings, while Yuanan asks his assembly to demonstrate the mind without fabrication. Retained public meaning is supported by independent present uses in recorded discourse.
